_note: English versions of services.json summaries, translated at development time (pre-generated, not real-time AI). Keep in sync with townpass-assistant/src/main/resources/services.json.
bus-arrivals: Tell me the bus route and the stop, and I will look up the official estimated arrival time. Arrival times may change with traffic. Data from the Taipei City Public Transportation Office.
road-report: You can report broken sidewalks, ramps or other barriers. First confirm the description and location, then submit it on the official system.
senior-card: You can apply for the senior citizen card at the Social Affairs Section of any district office in Taipei. Please check eligibility, required documents and proxy options on the Department of Social Welfare website.
disability-card: If your household is registered in Taipei and you hold a disability certificate, ask your district office about the Love Card. The Love Companion Card has separate eligibility rules; see the Department of Social Welfare website.
accessible-toilets: You can search Taipei public toilets by district and check the accessibility column. I cannot tell which facility is nearest to you or whether it is open right now.
accessible-taxi: If you need to ride in your wheelchair, contact an accessible taxi fleet listed by the Public Transportation Office, and confirm the vehicle and booking times with the fleet.
member-registration: You can register on the TaipeiPASS website or app. Please follow the verification steps on the official page.
member-login: Please go to the official login page. City platforms that support TaipeiPASS also let you log in by scanning a code with the app, as explained on the login page.
member-password: On the official login page, choose Forgot Password and complete the verification on screen. If your account is locked or you cannot receive email, see the official FAQ.
member-verification: Verify your identity in the TaipeiPASS app or website using the methods currently available. Please enter your details on the official page.
member-profile: Log in to TaipeiPASS to manage your member profile. Verification for changes and account deletion follows the official instructions.
taipeipass-help: TaipeiPASS offers cards, city services, bills and offers. Visit the official website for feature guides, the app download and customer service.
easycard-link: In the app's card section, follow the instructions to link your EasyCard. If a card is lost, check the reporting method of the card issuer or the EasyCard company.
virtual-cards: Log in to TaipeiPASS and open the card section to see your activated cards. Some services still require the physical card.
student-card: You can read about the student card in TaipeiPASS. For applications, replacements and school records, please ask your school.
child-card: Ask your district office about eligibility, documents and replacement for the child discount card.
library-card: Log in to the Taipei Public Library catalog system and choose to link with TaipeiPASS on your personal page.
pregnancy-card: Check the card and pregnancy taxi features in TaipeiPASS. Eligibility, amounts and participating fleets follow city announcements and your member screen.
welfare-cards: Log in to TaipeiPASS to see your activated cards. For eligibility, replacement or data changes, contact the issuing agency.
billing-overview: Open the bills feature in TaipeiPASS or go to the Taipei smart payment platform and choose the type of fee you want to look up.
parking-payment: You can look up Taipei parking fees in TaipeiPASS bills or the smart payment platform. Enter your plate number on the official screen.
water-payment: In TaipeiPASS bills, choose water bill and enter or link your water account number on the official screen.
school-payment: You can look up supported school fees in TaipeiPASS bills or the smart payment platform. Have the payment information from the school ready.
tax-payment: In TaipeiPASS bills, choose local taxes and scan your tax bill as the Revenue Service Office explains. Applicable taxes and deadlines follow the official page.
medical-payment: The smart payment platform lists payments for partner medical institutions. Please check the hospital and the official platform.
traffic-fines: Check the applicable Taipei traffic fine items on the smart payment platform. For other tickets, follow the issuing agency's instructions.
payment-history: Log in to TaipeiPASS bills or the smart payment platform to see paid items. Receipt and certificate rules for each fee follow the official instructions.
coupons: Find coupons in the TaipeiPASS offers section, then add them to your wallet or redeem them according to each coupon's rules. Check the coupon for dates and eligibility.
partner-offers: Search partner shops and offers in the TaipeiPASS offers section or on the official website. Check the coupon's limits before use.
city-applications: Use Taipei Service Pass to search for applications, see required documents, or log in to check the status of applications you have submitted.
counter-queue: In the TaipeiPASS services section, choose counter queueing and the agency to see the current number being served.
disaster-report: Use Taipei City's official disaster reporting system and enter the situation and location. If someone is injured, trapped or in immediate danger, call 119.
police-service: Check police services and procedures on the Police Department website. For emergencies that need immediate help, call 110.
participation: See current surveys and votes in the TaipeiPASS services section, and take part according to each activity's eligibility and period.
welfare-estimate: Check welfare information from the Taipei City Department of Social Welfare, then confirm eligibility, documents and how to apply in the official instructions.
city-learning: Go to Taipei e-University to search online courses and log in on the official page.
neighborhood: Find village offices, districts and contact details on the websites of the Department of Civil Affairs and the district offices.
library: Search for books in the Taipei Public Library catalog. Reservations, renewals and your borrowing record require logging in to the library system.
hospital: Go to the Taipei City Hospital website and choose the branch and the registration or consultation progress service.
vaccination: See the vaccination and booking information published by the Taipei City Department of Health. Eligible groups and times follow official announcements.
water-service: Enter Your Water Butler from the Taipei Water Department to check water outages, water quality, or log in to manage your water use.
parent-child-centers: See Taipei parent-child centers, opening hours and booking on the Department of Social Welfare website.
zoo: Check Taipei Zoo's opening hours, ticket prices and visitor information. Coupons follow the terms shown in the app.
taipei-radio: See program schedules, how to listen and news on the Taipei Broadcasting Station website.
essentials: See the daily essentials entry in the TaipeiPASS services section. Prices and announcements follow open data from the city or competent authorities.
subscriptions: Choose the topics you are interested in under messages or subscriptions in TaipeiPASS. Manage your subscription list and notification settings in the app.
city-news: See the latest city news and events on the city government website. Actual times and sign-up eligibility follow each announcement.
map-explore: In TaipeiPASS, open services and Find a Place to choose a theme map. The Taipei Travel website also lists attractions and events.
city-dashboard: See open city data and maps on the Taipei City Dashboard. Data times follow each layer's description.
road-construction: In TaipeiPASS Find a Place, choose construction information, or check the city's road announcements for the area and time of work.
trash-routes: Use the Department of Environmental Protection garbage collection search: choose your district and road to see collection points and times.
outdoors: See theme attractions in TaipeiPASS Explore Taipei, or search parks and trails on the Taipei Travel website. Entry limits follow on-site and official notices.
smoking-areas: In TaipeiPASS services, Find a Place, choose designated smoking areas. Actual areas and opening information follow city notices and on-site signs.
youbike: Check bikes available to borrow and free docks on the TaipeiPASS or official YouBike station map. Numbers follow the official live screen.
parking-locations: Look up parking lots through the Taipei City Parking Management and Development Office. Free spaces and accessible spaces follow on-site and official data.
